notes: Deterministic synthetic responder for pipeline testing. Reads the prompt text only. Outputs are SYNTHETIC MOCK DATA, never results.
Gemma's chat template has no separate system role; the template prepends the system prompt to the first user turn. Same text reaches the model, but note it when comparing models.
Mistral recommends `vllm serve ... --tokenizer-mode mistral --config-format mistral --load-format mistral`. Needs roughly 55 GB GPU memory in bf16.
